nom: Vacation Orange Gelée Spray Oil SPF 30

avis.texte: The spray function might work for two sprays and then quits working. Love the product but will be returning for a refund.
I ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS PRODUCT BRINGS ME BACK IN TIME! AND IT HAS A 30 SPF THANK YOU WILL DEFINITELY BE ORDERING MORE
Great purchase! Was in Palm Springs for a long weekend and didn't get burned whatsoever. I am very fair and this has long lasting power
I like the ease of a spray with the same deep tan of the original orange Gelee. Great coverage. No mess
This sunscreen is like a blast from the past!! Have used it for years. Love that it is available as a spray with the same great smell
The smell is amazing. The coverage is fantastic. The branding is everything. I LOVE IT
Awesome product. I like the spray feature. Plus this product produces a great tan. TY
Love the gelee. Smell is great (cloves I think). Feels good too. Tried the spray as well which is great for upper back. Thanks for bringing it back!!
Nothing and I mean nothing beats Orange Gelee!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! The sun kissed glow I get is exactly what I am looking for without the burn..
Feels great on my skin. The scent does not remind me of the original tho....
So happy to have the good ole Orange Jell back, used original Bon de sole early in life
I'd like to have my money back. I didn't remove one wrinkle I'm not that badly wrinkled. I'm just not a happy camper about it.
Bought the item. I am very happy with it and very happy with the quick shipping.

Bought this, the invisible face gel and the oil right before my Florida vacation. My pale skin hadn't been sun exposed in 6 long winter months and applied Orange Gelee 2x a day while being exposed to the sun 7 long hot days and it did its job. No sunburn and bonus my skin felt great. A little goes a long way as well

I bought this product a few weeks ago and used it (gel) for the first time this weekend sitting outside on my back deck. The smell is amazing and took me back to when I was younger laying out with my mom! It leaves a nice glow on your skin that is not sticky and smells so good that I didn't take a shower before I went out to dinner.😂. Hydrating too! I wish it came in larger sizes.!

avis.titre: NOT A FULL CAN OF LOTION
avis.texte: I was so excited to take this away with me on vacation. I loved it for the first two days and then the can was empty. So disappointed! I have had so many aerosol tanning lotions in my 71 years that have lasted me the whole summer, but never two days. So unhappy.
This is now my favorite suntan lotion - it's just like Ban de Soleil, but in a spray bottle! Same great smell but easy to use and leaves me with a great tan
I love Vacation products! These are the only tanning products that I use!! Brings back great memories❤️
This scent immediately ported me to the beach and summer vacations. My day was sunshine and 75 and I'm loving it!!!!

avis.titre: Sticky and smelled like baby oil. Not like orangey
avis.texte: ….zest that Bain du Doleil had. I'm not using it. Made my clothes smell like baby oil

Provides tan contrast and improves skin conditioning. I use daily applied to my face , arms , legs ... The fragrance is very inviting and I have had several positive comments re: the fragrance and also the shimmer following application...will be purchasing more for presents this Christmas..

I used Bain de solie for years…. Now use the enhanced 30 spf vacation product every day! Found that this product keeps your skin moist and thus does not burn! The spray is good but a little too oily for my taste. Will continue to use the gel for years to come. My dermatologist says keep using what I am using because the results are apparent on my skin.
My niece recommended your product for my recent trip to Florida. I loved it!

I was a loyal fan of Bain de Soleil, and was so sad when they stopped producing it, so I am elated that you worked hard and made a product that is incredibly close to our past favorite! This is the 3rd tube that I have bought!
I used the original Orange Gelee for 40 years and am so ecstatic you have picked up the baton with your new product!
The cap makes a squeal like the souls of a thousand sinners. I had to wipe half of the product off because it made me so greasy. The smell is very strong and lingering. Would not purchase again.
I love the application!! I love the scent, it glides on and makes you look so good. Honestly the texture is perfect might switch over to this one permanently over the champagne oil

avis.titre: Sun protection and a beautiful tan!
avis.texte: This is my new favorite spray oil! Moisturizing and smells great, I got a great tan without getting crispy! < 3
I really dont get the negative reviews. Thisbuse to be bon de soil and it was my holy grail. Now they have it in vacation brand and an spray. SOLD! The best golden bronze tan.

I was very disappointed. You advertise it is just like Bain de Soliel, even the scent. I'm a person who used Bain de Soliel for many many years and your product is nothing like it. You can't even compare the scents. I should have returned it.
Spray does not work! Please replace with one that does or refund
Great scent, great coverage. All over happy with my purchase.

avis.titre: Slimy oil that gets on everything
avis.texte: I don't really like sunscreen to begin with, and I hated this one. I bought it because people were saying how great it smells. I didn't find the scent to be great, but I didn't dislike it either. The people around me said it smelled alright, but kind of strange. The part I truly hated was that this spray made me feel so greasy! I couldn't get it to absorb. It's been hours since I applied it, and I still feel gross and greasy. Plus, it went everywhere. It got on my face, on my chair, in my car, on my desk while typing this. It's just everywhere!

avis.titre: Wonderful smell and feels great on the skin
avis.texte: I was interested in finding something to replace my former sunscreen. So pleased! Brings me back!
Best tanning spray on the market! Give a deep tan and smells incredible
This sunscreen works great. Even color, deep tone, like the old Ban de Soleil SPF 2 just with a modern twist as this comes in spray and with higher SPF that is better skin protection. Loving it!
I used Bain de Soleil my entire life! I love that this product is so similar, and provides more protection for my skin.
The smell of the spray oil brings us back to the 70s when Bain de Soliel was all we used. The oil is light but luxurious.

I haven't been stung by a bee since I was 10 years old, so it's been over 20 years. I got stung twice within a 2 hour period my first time using this sunscreen. The bergamot scent is a known to attract bees and other pollinators and I should've known better than to wear a sunscreen like this. I've had no issues with the regular vacation sunscreens so I'll just stick to those!

I was disappointed in amount in the bottle. I had regular sunscreen 3 people used everyday and this I only use with one day my son using and it didnt last the whole 6 days but the other brand is still going. I will stick to the gel much more product for your money.

avis.titre: Old school is now the New School!
avis.texte: The marketing campaign was cheerfull, nostalgic and very inviting. The spray bottle sprays out the perfect amount of pressure, volume and coverage. Even the least amount gives a smooth, silky feel that spreads easily. And of course it's got that smell, that wonderful smell of yesterday's fun in the sun in the '70s! The top has an easy twist to lock and unlock so no separate top is needed to protect or lose :)
I used the spray at the beach and it was great. Love the ease of using it and it smells great
Cap makes a weird squealing noise when applied and the product puddles and drips around the cap. Not pleasant.
Feels great, smells great, but it does't seem to have that orange tint that i love sbout the gelee. Slightly disappointing.

avis.titre: Takes Me Back to My Bain de Soliel Days
avis.texte: Nearly perfect copy of the original in a convenient spray. Just adore it1 Careful though it can stain your towels.

avis.titre: I love this product. Smells great. Works great.
avis.texte: Next order i will buy 2 at a time. It was delivered quickly. All my friends have asked to try it. I highly recommend it.
Love this product. It smells like my early days of tanning but with SPF

avis.titre: Smells like cloves, protects skin, slip and slide
avis.texte: Smells great, but far greasier than the original product. Doesn't absorb in, but does keep skin "moisturized" (really greasy).
Just love the Orange Gelee products. Takes me to a happy place.
This goes on so easy, smells great, and works even better! Still get a tan and no burn with additional applications.
I always loved the orange gelee SPF of the past and this brings me back!

avis.titre: It smells like the '80s, in a good way!
avis.texte: Chill with some good vintage tunes and safely tan to your hearts delight. This amazing product goes on with a fine mist for even, full coverage. A must have this summer.
I love the gelee. it smells great. it makes putting on sunscreen fun
Love the scent. Good coverage and good SPF. Too early in season to test efficacy

avis.titre: Reminds me of back in the day
avis.texte: I love this product. It just is what summer means to me. The time when I feel most alive.

Reminds me of the old Bain de Soleil gelee of the 1960's, now gone. It smells okay with just a trace of chemical odor. A little goes a long way and it beads up on skin when in the pool so you know it's there. I burned a little on first use however.

avis.titre: So glad it's in a spray
avis.texte: I love the gel for what it does (has anyone noticed that mosquitos don't like the smell? Bonus points) but it was very thick so I'm looking forward to enjoying the product with less mess this Summer
I was excited to receive this as I have fond memories of the orange gelee from many years ago. Unfortunately I don't care for the smell at all
It reminds me of bans du Soleil. It is the best. The smell is perfect.
I have every item in this product line and love them all! Love the variety I get to choose from depending on the day and activity. Brings back favorite memories using the gelee❤️
Is what it is. Nothing spectacular. Way too expensive for what you get

Hi I ordered 3 because I love the gel but tube gets hard to squeeze .. So I order the spray .. Love it!!!! Just when you press to spray it makes a terrible noise. I tried open/ shut and still does it. I didn't try the other 2 cans as they arrived after I went out of town . My hubby brought me one can when he arrived. I won't be back till July to test others . Just thought I'd let you know… more annoying than anything and not sure it's coming out the way it should spray. Thank You. MS
This product does not disappoint. Exact fragrance, and feel that brings back all memories of the 70's and 80's beach love! Love it! Thankyou
I love the original gelee but putting it in a spray is life changing. I'm not the biggest fan of sprays. But it just goes on with such ease. It's definitely my staple sunscreen this summer.

I've used other Vacation products and this one is 2nd to worst with the worst being the Gel version. The spray cap would scream when pressing down on it and the product was coming out the bottom and top of the cap. The product itself is EXTREMELY OILY and does not sit on the skin like the original Vacation sunscreen. I would not recommend nor purchase again unless they reformulate or place in another vessel.
Loved the smell and look. Pretty great though, got on everything. I'll still use.

The campy vintage branding of Vacation products, just makes my high-quality sunscreens and fragrances even better. I wear the Vacation fragrance daily. Orange Gelee, once again, makes me want to strive to be the Ban de Soleil girl. This fantastic sunscreen takes me back to a time when I din't worry about wearing sunscreen AT ALL.
The smell takes me to the beach. I love that it's not drying for a spray. This will be the on sunscreen I use this year

my 1st came, it would not dispense. Finally able to teach CS, they sent another. This one did actually spray. the smell on this is NOT attractive at all. I'm pretty sure this will stay on the and be used sparingly. it just isn't attractive and NO I would not buy again.
Great product. Just like the one I used and loved years ago by Bain De Soleil. Will definitely order this again.

Very oily and must rub in extremely thoroughly. It also makes you oily for a long time and will get oil on everything you touch. The spray bottle also gets very slippery/oily. I generally like spray for its ease and ability to apply without getting my hands all oily, but this is not that!
I have the gelee, too, that I use as moisturizer. This is easy to apply, dries quickly. Perfect for the beach.
It brings me back to the good old days of sunbathing at the beach.
I love it! It smells good. It feels good on my skin. Love the glow!
Need another bottle. Love the spray I have always purchased the cream.
Received product, tried the dispenser attached and it will not work. Now I have to send a video displaying how it doesn't work.
Everything I wanted it to be. The amazing smell of Bain Du Soliel, silky skin during and after use, and 30spf.
Very happy to say I loved this product. It applies very easily and smells wonderful. Will Definitely buy it again

The product is a good one. But the customer service is not good. Delivery literally takes many weeks between payment online, confirmation of payment, assurances that the product will be shipped shortly, and finally weeks later delivery. It seems like there is no stock on hand but rather, they make it after they already have your money. Big improvement needed to entire delivery process.
I love all things Vacation, and this great smelling spray is a great way to stay protected fast.

avis.titre: Reminds me of when I was a teenager!
avis.texte: I always loved the orange gel suntan lotion. Can't wait to use it. Just received it a couple of days ago.

avis.titre: Great Product. But 1 can was damaged
avis.texte: I would have liked to give this product a rating of 5. But on my trip to St.Martin in March, I brought 3 cans of the orange Helene and went to use my last can my final week and the spray would not work, I took the lid off and could see that spout was damaged. It was very disappointed .
A bit too oily for me. If I could have rubbed it in it would have made a difference.
Love the spray! Great for a quick reapply! So happy to have found this.

Same gorgeous smell! Looking forward to trying the spray oil for the first time if we ever see a sunny day! I have been using the Vacation Gel & well of course it is my fave! Will enjoy having two besties in my beach bag.
I was such a fan when I was younger of the ban de soles. I love this spray
Had high hopes this would be a winner. Sadly, there is a funky smell that overshadows the barely there original.

Used the spray oil for the fist time poolside in Las Vegas...the smell alone takes me back to the 80s! The spray bottle makes a funny noise when dispensing, so not sure about that. But it came out nicely and evenly...not overly greasy feeling.
Amazing smell. Quality is spot on. Everything you could want in a can.
It is a very oily product, and the smell is completely different than what was described. It did arrive fast though.
I really enjoyed using this spray oil. It was wonderful on vacation and Cancun and I'm looking forward to using it again and again this summer.
spray it like it's hot! to tan, to look shinny, to smell yummy: epic epic.
I loved this gelee! Used it on a cruise and avoided sunburn while smelling amazing
Love it!! Best tan I've ever had. The smell is amazing and not sticky

This spray is sooo much better than any others that I've tried. It doesn't feel or smell like sunscreen, it feels like you rubbed tanning oil on. The smell is divine, being a teenager in the 80's, this takes me back!

avis.titre: It leaves my skin so moisturized
avis.texte: I brought the old orange one so I was excited to try the new Vacation suntan products!! Love them!! And thanks for the squeeze tool!!
I love this luxurious feeling product. It smells like vacation, feels like silk, and helps create a beautiful tan.

avis.titre: I Didn't Think Orange Gelee Could Get Any Better!
avis.texte: Orange Gelee Spray is a game changer! It's everything I love about Orange Gelee (THE SCENT) without the oil feeling. It goes on so easily and smell amazing. I think the scent of the spray lingers for a longer period of time than the original in a tube. I love this stuff!!!!!!

Love that this product is available! After decades of use, a similar product used by both my mom (now passed) and me, went off the market. Finding this product makes me so happy! It even smells close to the old product! Thank you for making this available. 💖
I ended up not using it, however it smelled good. Would definitely try it again next vacation
